note: Provincial-park campgrounds near the north-east shore of Jackfish Lake, set back in aspen woods behind the day-use beach, its parking lots and a golf course. Centre and North make up the core area; South campground sits about 1.7 km down the shore on its own road. 52 North sites are seasonal. --Claude
